audit.why: Lane difficulty is correctly framed as an even skill matchup that swings on who lands Dredge Line first; carried through diff/tone/breakdown.difficulty consistently.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart (phases[1/4/5/6].side) is flat 'Skill' on rows the content layer (win[1]=Nautilus, win[4]=Maokai, win[5]=Nautilus, win[6]=Maokai) and the packet's real levelChart already correctly call for the enemy or owner.
audit.why: Nautilus's Q Dredge Line (14/13/12/11/10s) plus his passive on-hit root out-threatens Maokai's W at level 2 before Maokai has R; at 6 Maokai's Nature's Grasp out-ranges Depth Charge; a first tank item lets Nautilus's hook+passive+W shield brawl through Maokai's chain; by two-plus items Maokai's AoE R and Saplings win the disengage-into-engage.
audit.corrected: Move phases[1].side to Nautilus, phases[4].side to Maokai, phases[5].side to Nautilus, phases[6].side to Maokai, rewriting each .why to match (see edits).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Dredge Line as matchup-defining but carries no actual cooldown number, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles instead of stating the interaction the title promises.
audit.why: Dredge Line is 14s at rank 1 falling to 10s at rank 5 — that number is what lets a reader plan around it. 'W the post-catch chain' should describe landing W after the hook whiffs, not restate general trade philosophy; 'Trade at his tempo' should explain why fighting on his cooldown clock loses, not restate the same tradeBad line already shown elsewhere.
audit.corrected: See edits for breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d.
